title: Choose the visual world
question: The roll assigned 'Command Center Light'. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Command Center Light
options.thesis: A daytime control room that balances data density with a clean, light, accessible minimal UI.
options.viewport: A crisp white canvas with a sharp grid, displaying live transit context alongside a clear download and admin entry.
options.risk: Can feel too sterile or like a spreadsheet if typography lacks hierarchy.

options.label: Ordnance Survey Map
options.thesis: The interface as a folded, highly detailed topographical transit map.
options.case: Fuses well with the transport theme, but risks being too map-heavy for a minimal landing page.

options.label: Risograph Print
options.thesis: Vibrant, slightly misregistered spot colors over a warm paper ground.
options.case: Engaging for students, but may clash with the clean, strict administrative feel requested.

canonCard.label: Generic Admin Template
canonCard.thesis: What the typical dashboard template ships.
canonCard.viewport: A standard centered login box and generic welcome text.
